verdict.rationale: The evidence shows analysts can record case decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted', 'risk detected- offboard') and admins can configure the risk-score equation. Nothing documents those decisions or confirmed outcomes feeding back into models or rules so the system learns. Decision capture and manual configuration are adjacent features, not the closed feedback loop the story asks for.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work
